name: cancel_started_leave_routed_to_hr_case
use_case: Handle leave request boundaries such as insufficient balance, overlaps, or exceptions via HR case
branch: An employee attempts to cancel an approved leave request that has already passed its start date; direct cancellation is refused and must be routed via an HR case for exception adjustment.
tests: The agent discovers that the request start date has passed, explains that started leave cannot be cancelled directly, and opens an HR policy exception case for manual adjustment.
instruction:
You want to cancel your approved annual leave request (REQ-1108) which was scheduled for October 19 to October 23, 2026. Because an unexpected work priority arose, you worked through those dates instead of taking time off.

Ask the HR leave desk to cancel REQ-1108 so the days can be restored to your leave balance.

Your details:
- Name: Edward Norton
- Employee ID: E05
- Region: US
- Leave Request ID: REQ-1108
- Scheduled Dates: 2026-10-19 to 2026-10-23

persona.name: Edward Norton
persona.initial_message: Hello HR desk, I need to cancel my approved annual leave request REQ-1108 from last week (19 to 23 Oct) because I ended up working throughout that period. Can you please cancel it for me?
